[P2] Preserve names of downstream subclasses

For `class CustomStepError extends StepError {}`, `new CustomStepError().name` changes from `"CustomStepError"` to `"StepError"`, even without minification. This initializer runs after `DurableOperationError` assigns the constructor name, overwriting the fallback that the PR says it preserves. The same issue affects subclasses of the other changed concrete errors, breaking callers that distinguish them by `name`. Restrict literal assignment to instances constructed as the corresponding SDK class, preserving the fallback for downstream subclasses, and add a regression test extending a concrete SDK error.
